exact_acceptance_condition: Adapters only for verified access families, one per family with per-seat constraints; Stage-3 adapters reused only where an identity binding proves the same resource; no speculative adapters (§8.24.5); query construction stays with the Builder (D-04)
evidence_required: Adapter code under Gate B; family evidence; tests
denominator_rule: Source count is NOT an acceptance criterion unless the original contract explicitly makes it one — it does not. Denominator is verified access families with required family evidence, not an arbitrary N of connected sources.
required_dimensions: one adapter per family with per-seat constraints
Stage-3 reuse only with identity binding proving same resource
not_required_by_original_wording: External API for every seat (Dr. Duke limited LocalIndex projection is owner-accepted under OD-G1-17)
supporting_owner_scope_decisions: OD-G1-01-SCOPE-BOUNDED-SUBSET — bounded AGRIS ODS subset; full corpus not claimed
OD-G1-17-SCOPE-LIMITED-PROJECTION — limited Dr. Duke LocalIndex projection; no public API claimed
family_matrix_basis: 2026-11-12-PHASE-1-EXIT-08-FAMILY-VERIFICATION-MATRIX + live/search updates through v10.10.1-bhl and v10.14
rationale: Access-family adapter packages exist (RestJson, OAI-PMH, Bulk/LocalIndex) with Gate B foundation authorization (§8.82) and substantial live/search evidence for GBIF/BHL/OE/AGRIS-bounded/Duke-limited paths, but family closure is not uniformly VERIFIED (Consensus credentials, Semantic Scholar 429, FAOSTAT NOT_TESTED, Bulk integration_verified still advancing).
